- From 12pm to 2pm, she was driving to the water park.
- From 2pm to 3pm, she was at the airport.
- From 3pm to 4pm, she was at the electronics store.

Since the art show was closed after 4pm, and Lisa was occupied from 2pm to 4pm, the only possible time slot for her to go to the art show would be between 12pm and 2pm, when she was driving to the water park.
